title: M9-C42.26 — 14-Component Population Ledger (Component Matrix)
purpose: Distinguish AUTHORITATIVE MEASURED / TARGETED MEASURED / MATHEMATICALLY RECONCILED / NOT EXECUTED evidence to prevent future agents from falsely claiming a 14-component full campaign was executed.

ledger_evidence_statuses.AUTHORITATIVE MEASURED: Component was part of an executed mutmut run with full evidence (counts, per-component mutation score, per-mutant classification).
ledger_evidence_statuses.AUTHORITATIVE TARGETED MEASURED: Component was part of an executed mutmut targeted smoke with full evidence; coverage bounded but not a full campaign.
ledger_evidence_statuses.MATHEMATICALLY RECONCILED: Score is derived by combining authoritative inputs arithmetically. NOT an executed measurement.
ledger_evidence_statuses.NOT EXECUTED: No measurement run; component may or may not be in the population but its score is not stated.

components.scope: 12-component full campaign (evaluated=5258 after discovery repair, generated=7213 with 1955 no_tests)

components.source_artifact: runtime/generated/m9-c42.24/summaries/common_calculations-mutation-summary.json (implicit in C42.24-B full; per-component summary from C42.24)
components.note: Per-engine summary file not in m9-c42.24/summaries/; aggregate derived from C42.21/C42.24 component matrices and full-campaign rollup. Original evidence valid and unaffected by C42.26 expansion.

components.methodology: bounded smoke — representative operators across conditional/arithmetic/comparison/return/boolean domains
bounded smoke — representative operators across conditional/arithmetic/comparison/return/boolean domains

aggregate_status.label: MATHEMATICALLY RECONCILED
aggregate_status.note: Aggregate is derived from the sum of AUTHORITATIVE MEASURED (12) + AUTHORITATIVE TARGETED MEASURED (2) inputs. It is NOT a freshly executed 14-component full campaign.

fresh_14_component_full_campaign.rationale: M26.10 decision gate: no source change, no infra change, no config change, no population fingerprint change, no cross-component interference detected. C42.24-B + C42.25 evidence is internally consistent. No trigger condition met. Reusing certified evidence is the correct, forensic-rigorous operation.

audit_warning: Future agents must NOT claim a '14-component full mutation campaign was executed' from this ledger. The 14-component aggregate is mathematically reconciled, not measured. Any claim that requires a freshly executed 14-component run must explicitly motivate a new run per M26.10 trigger conditions.
